hook: Your coding agents, playing like music on your Mac

beats.say: AgentSaver is a Mac screen saver for coding agents. Claude Code, Codex and OpenCode keep working while their replies stream across the lock screen like song lyrics.
Frosted cards sit under the clock where Now Playing would, showing the task, its progress and the command running right now. You skip between agents like tracks.
It reads sessions already running, with zero setup, and an optional Claude Code hook flags approval requests. It costs 7.99 dollars.
